tagline: Designing and manufacturing consumer and building products that improve everyday life by elevating spaces and experiences
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex of $50.6 B in 2025 reflects the strategic commitment to productive investments following the separation of the steel business, supporting growth in the Consumer Products and Building Products segments.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Fixed Assets)
kpis.explanation: Money spent to acquire or improve factories, machinery, or equipment.
kpis.description: Capex of $50.6 M in 2025 reflects sustained investment in operations following the separation of the steel business.
kpis.signal: Stable investment in productive capacity despite asset divestiture.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash generated by the company's core operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow decreased from $290.0 M in 2024 to $209.7 M in 2025, primarily due to lower net revenues following the separation and a $33.7 M decrease in dividends received from joint ventures.
kpis.signal: Decline driven by reduced post-separation earnings and lower joint venture dividends.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not provided in the extracted documents.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not provided in the extracted documents.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount spent on research and development of new products and applications.
kpis.description: R&D expenses are not separately disclosed in the documents. The company emphasizes its commitment to developing and commercializing new products and applications.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Employee count is not provided in the extracted documents.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.7 B in the most recent year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.33 B in the most recent year
